name: ui_egress
description: xi.ui.egress — the LIVE-UI egress service-middleware lib plugin (docs/new_gen/31). NO data plane: it never emits and nothing routes to it. On create it registers the capability xi.ui.egress (push a preview image to a UI channel — writes a latest-wins retained slot and returns immediately, never blocking the lane). An own timer thread at the UI rate (default 30fps) flushes each channel's slot: content-keyed LRU dedup -> dispatch by descriptor 't' (xi/image u8 -> xi.jpeg.encode at q80, >2MP box-downscaled to <=1MP; xi/jpeg pass-through; unknown -> metadata card) -> hand to expose (pure transport). Fail-open at every seam: no jpeg cap -> raw fallback; no subscriber -> drop at zero cost.
_lib_doc: lib plugin marker (doc 14/31): a capability provider + service middleware, not a pipeline stage — do not wire it as an input/output of anything; create one instance and let producers reach xi.ui.egress by capability name through the host funnel.
_autoload_doc: V3 machine-level autoload ELIGIBILITY: marks this lib provider safe to instantiate once at service boot under a machine owner, so xi.ui.egress is available WITHOUT any project declaring a per-instance. ELIGIBILITY ONLY — the host autoloads eligible providers only when the deployment opts in (backend flag --autoload-lib / env XINSP2_AUTOLOAD_LIB); the default deployment is byte-unchanged. A project that DOES declare a ui_egress instance takes precedence for its life.
_reentrant_doc: the push handler is invoked by the host funnel WITHOUT per-instance serialization (the provider thread-safety contract) — arbitrary producer threads push concurrently; the control surface (exchange/set_def) may also run concurrently. All state is mutex/atomic-guarded and a single own timer thread is the sole flusher.
_on_fault_doc: a push handler that faulted should stop serving (quarantine) rather than keep writing from possibly-corrupt state; consumers see -3 and the operator re-enables by re-committing config.

params.name: fps
params.doc: UI flush rate (frames/second) of the own timer thread

params.name: downscale_mp
params.doc: images larger than downscale_mp megapixels are box-downscaled before encode (default 2 -> target ~1MP)

capabilities.name: xi.ui.egress
capabilities.doc: Pack in: str '$channel' (UI channel; default ui/<instance>), blob 'image' (an xi/image or xi/jpeg self-describing blob), or bool '$probe'. Writes a latest-wins retained slot for the channel and returns {i64 'ok':1} immediately (never blocks). The own timer thread encodes + fans out to expose at the UI rate.

exchange.doc: -> {pushes, flushes, encodes, dedup_hits, dropped_no_sub, raw_fallbacks, lru_entries, registered} — encodes vs dedup_hits is the dedup proof
drain the retained slots + encode LRU -> {ok:true}
